description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I: Yda] and [Monk Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode I: Yda
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Hypervigilance after a ally uses a Monk ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (15s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Monk Mode II: Yda] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I: Yda] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode II: Yda
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Monk abilities, grants [100% Critical 1] to the user after using Monk abilities, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using Monk abilities if 4+ FF14 allies are alive

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Dual Hypervigilance
description.text: One single attack (1.02), 100% hit rate, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[HP Stock (2000)]/[Monk Quick Cast 3]/[Monk +30% Boost 2]/[Dualcast Monk 1] to all allies after 1+5n/2+5n/3+5n/4+5n/5+5n casts

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
